title: Robot Learning Data Atlas
subtitle: Where robot learning data comes from, what it contains, and how it can be used.
note: Datasets catalogue and reported quantities from the Why Humanoid? master workbook. Quantities are transcribed from public sources as stated, not independently counted. Sizes are compared only within a compatible group and unit; they are not a ranking of quality, and nothing is summed across resources because collections overlap. Aggregates, provider claims and training mixtures are kept apart from open-corpus sizes. Access and licence notes are summaries: check the original terms before use.

lanes.label: Robot-recorded
lanes.note: Recorded on physical robots: teleoperation, scripted or policy rollouts.

lanes.label: Human observation and motion
lanes.note: Human video, motion capture and hand or body pose. No robot actions unless a resource retargets them.

lanes.label: Synthetic, simulated and retargeted
lanes.note: Generated in simulation, or derived from other data such as human motion retargeted to robots.

lanes.label: Environment assets
lanes.note: Scenes and objects for generating data or evaluating, not recorded episodes.

lanes.label: Mixed origins
lanes.note: Robot, human and simulated data combined in one resource or training mixture.

lanes.label: Origin not established or not applicable
lanes.note: Services and portals whose data origin the public pages do not establish, or that hold no data of their own.
